location.rationale: This setting controls the location of the view, which could have security implications if not properly managed.

display_name.description: The human-readable display name of the view.
display_name.rationale: Used for identification purposes only. No direct security impact.

value.description: A filter to reduce conversation results to a specific subset. Refer to https://cloud.google.com/contact-center/insights/docs/filtering for details.
value.rationale: Defines conversation filtering behaviour only. No direct security impact.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Defines the project context only. No direct security impact.
